title: Agent Platform reference adapter and contract harness

requirements.statement: Agent Platform adapter is registered in the canonical TSIC adapter registry.
The reference adapter does not own identity, authorization, policy, runtime, secrets, budgets, or evidence authority.
The adapter preserves tenant and authenticated-principal context without replacement.
The adapter requires idempotency for retriable consequential operations.
The adapter preserves trace and correlation context across the integration boundary.
MCP/A2A authorization remains owned by Agent Platform while TSIC governs the interoperability contract.
Authoritative evidence remains owned by Agent Platform and is referenced rather than recreated by TSIC.
The TSIC forensic audit validates the adapter registration and contract binding set.
